info.title: Model Integrity Inspector API
info.description: M0-06 development contract; formal approval deferred. No operation is claimed implemented solely by appearing here. All /api/v1 routes use envelopes except audited binary/HTML downloads and SSE. All business IDs are decimal strings. No multi-tenant authorization by frontend-only filtering.

get.summary: Read a bounded organization overview for 7 or 30 local calendar days

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Includes the current unfinished day in the organization's stored IANA timezone. Empty, signed, padded, repeated and unknown query parameters are rejected.

200.description: One authorized database snapshot. Closed S1-only organization aggregate; no upstream calls, response decryption, dataset sampling or report generation.

400.description: Invalid, repeated, empty or unknown query/header input. Only days=7 or days=30 is allowed.

401.description: Current persisted session is required.

403.description: Both run.read and target.read in the current organization are required; system administration is not a wildcard. Forced password changes also deny access.

409.description: Initialization is still required.

429.description: MI_OVERVIEW_BUSY: non-blocking aggregation capacity is exhausted; retry is caller-controlled.

Retry-After.description: Aggregation busy response uses 2 seconds; the client does not automatically retry.

500.description: Closed unexpected server error; never substitute empty overview data.

503.description: Overview limit, deadline, invalid organization timezone, database unavailability or malformed persisted S1 summary. No partial/truncated statistics are returned.

get.description: Run membership uses created_at in [start_utc,as_of), not completion or Attempt timestamps. Current target directory counts are independent of the window. Risk distribution is separately grouped by package and the four frozen versions, published revision 1 only; unscored and unpublished Runs remain separate. COMPLETED is a Run status, not an HTTP success rate. Known cost subtotal is an estimate, never a supplier invoice; incomplete totals stay null. A single snapshot revalidates current session/account/organization/membership and both permissions. Limits fail explicitly rather than truncate, and all figures are development/uncalibrated. No request/response content, endpoint or credential is read.

get.summary: List one target's persisted per-Run risk, confidence and attempt trends

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque signed cursor, valid for 24 hours, bound to reader user, organization, trends resource/revision 1, normalized filters and q. Cannot be reused for /runs, another reader/organization or different filters. Page size may change. Newest created_at DESC,id DESC ordering; a normal anchor status change does not invalidate its position.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed UTF-8 text, at most 128 bytes; NUL/CR/LF and duplicate parameters are rejected. Matches current live target metadata, not the frozen historical request. Literal case-insensitive substring of current target name/model; wildcard characters are escaped.

parameters.name: target_id
parameters.description: Required positive decimal ID. A nonexistent or foreign target produces an empty page within the already-authorized organization; this endpoint does not disclose target existence. Deleted targets retain historical target_id.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Trimmed UTF-8 text, at most 128 bytes; NUL/CR/LF and duplicate parameters are rejected. Matches current live target metadata, not the frozen historical request. Exact current model filter; explicitly empty values are rejected.

parameters.name: channel_id
parameters.description: Trimmed UTF-8 text, at most 128 bytes; NUL/CR/LF and duplicate parameters are rejected. Matches current live target metadata, not the frozen historical request. Exact current channel_id filter; explicitly empty values are rejected.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Inclusive Run created_at boundary, parsed as RFC3339Nano and normalized to UTC for cursor binding. date_from must not be later than date_to.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Inclusive Run created_at boundary, parsed as RFC3339Nano and normalized to UTC for cursor binding. date_from must not be later than date_to.

200.description: Bounded S1 trend page with at most 100 Run items and an opaque next_cursor. success_rate_percent=100*succeeded/dispatched, including retries and uncertain/in-flight dispatches in the explicit denominator; not a future probability or sample completion rate. Unknown/in-flight are not labelled failed. Latency uses observed completed successes and failures only; missing latency is null, genuine 0ms is retained, UNCERTAIN recovery placeholders are excluded. Current target metadata is live and may be null after deletion. Values are not aggregated across this page or claimed representative of all historical Runs.

400.description: Missing/malformed target_id or organization header; invalid/duplicate/unknown filters, invalid date range, or malformed/expired/tampered/wrong-scope cursor. No raw parameters or bodies are returned.

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked session, disabled user or password/session invalidation.

403.description: Missing or revoked organization membership/run.read, disabled organization, or mandatory password change. Evidence permission is not required for these aggregate S1 statistics.

409.description: The application has not yet completed first-time initialization.

429.description: Reserved common gateway rate-limit contract. The current trends handler does not implement an independent rate limiter; this declaration does not claim one.

500.description: Closed error from the common unexpected-panic protection; no raw exception text.

503.description: Unavailable database/reader authority or invalid persisted S1 data. Unknown versions/status/validity, broken Run/sample/Attempt binding, request_count mismatch, out-of-range duration or resource bounds fail closed. Never substitute an empty success page or fabricated zero statistics.

get.description: Requires run.read and a current session in X-Organization-ID, revalidated in the same read snapshot as the Run page and its attempt aggregates. target_id is mandatory. Returns only this bounded newest-first Run page, never a whole-target/global summary. Published risk/confidence uses revision 1 with frozen version identifiers and development/uncalibrated limitations. Independent target prechecks are not Run attempts. Request counters must match persisted dispatched attempts; malformed S1 data fails closed rather than inventing a denominator. No request/response bodies, evidence ciphertext or raw upstream errors are read.
get.x-query-policy: Only declared query parameters are accepted once each. target_id must be present. analysis_revision/include are not accepted: the result revision is fixed at 1.

post.summary: Revoke every session of the authenticated account, including this session
post.description: Self-service only: no user or organization selector, no password change, and no administrator grant required. Temporary-password sessions may use this route. User and initiating session are revalidated under lock; all revocations and audit events commit atomically. A login serialized after that commit may create a new session. Network failure does not establish whether the transaction committed; clients must not automatically replay this write.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly match the configured public origin; cross-site requests are rejected.

requestBody.description: Exactly an empty JSON object. Empty body, null, extra fields and all query parameters are rejected.

200.description: Revocation and audit transaction committed; current browser cookie is expired. No session IDs, counts or tokens are returned.

Set-Cookie.description: Expires current HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict session cookie; Secure follows deployment policy.

400.description: MI_INVALID_REQUEST: nonempty/invalid JSON or query selector.

401.description: MI_SESSION_REQUIRED: missing, expired, revoked or otherwise invalid session.

403.description: MI_CSRF_INVALID: Origin or per-session CSRF check rejected the request.

409.description: MI_SETUP_REQUIRED: initialization has not completed.

413.description: MI_INVALID_REQUEST: request exceeds the fixed JSON body limit.

429.description: Reserved common admission failure; this route does not currently use the login limiter.

503.description: MI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: canceled/deadline, database or audit failure. Do not infer successful revocation from this response.

SessionCookie.name: mii_session
SessionCookie.description: Opaque random session; server stores hash only; HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict. Local HTTP exception requires explicit loopback development configuration.

SystemStatus.description: Read-only local-process and selected-organization observations. Startup checks are not current capability probes. Unimplemented monitoring, retention enforcement, periodic quotas and backup stay unavailable.

observed_state.description: Only the observed checks; not overall readiness or full-system health.

daily.description: Exactly window.days local calendar buckets, ordered oldest first; only the last bucket is partial. Empty days are retained.

id.description: Response-local cohort identity assigned by a deterministic package/version tuple sort. Not a persistent database ID, cross-window identity or authorization token.

complete_total_micros.description: Equal to known_subtotal_micros only when at least one Run has a known estimate and unknown_runs=0; otherwise null, including an empty window.

known_subtotal_micros.description: Sum of known persisted Run estimates only, in integer USD micros, not invoices. Null when known_runs=0; an observed known zero remains 0.

cohort_id.description: Response-local cohort identity assigned by a deterministic package/version tuple sort. Not a persistent database ID, cross-window identity or authorization token.

partial.description: True only for the current unfinished local day, whose exclusive end is as_of; do not compare this partial count as a complete day's improvement.

OverviewDistribution.description: Counts of scored, published revision-1 results in one exact package/four-version cohort. Null scores and unpublished Runs are separate, never low risk. These are descriptive counts, not calibrated probabilities, causal anomalies or a new threshold.

OverviewStatuses.description: Current Run statuses counted once per Run created in the window. COMPLETED is not upstream request success; no Attempt success-rate is calculated here.

OverviewTargets.description: Current non-deleted target directory counts, including disabled targets, independent of the Run time window; not endpoint availability.

as_of.description: The fixed observation instant for this authorized read snapshot; equals end_utc.

end_utc.description: Exclusive UTC end, equal to as_of. Run membership uses created_at, not finished_at or Attempt timestamps.

start_utc.description: Inclusive UTC instant of local midnight window.days-1 dates before today.

timezone.description: Current organization IANA location or UTC; Local and unknown locations fail closed. Calendar days follow this location, including DST, not fixed UTC 24-hour intervals.

business_review.description: overall_risk >= 40 时必填；仅组织业务说明。

failed.description: Known COMPLETED attempts with non-valid final outcomes, including HTTP/protocol/safety/cancellation failures. Does not include UNCERTAIN or DISPATCHED attempts.

latency_max_ms.description: Observed client-side total duration in milliseconds; null when latency_samples=0. Real observed 0ms is retained. Not time-to-first-token, P95, server compute time or an inferred latency for missing observations.

latency_mean_ms.description: Observed client-side total duration in milliseconds; null when latency_samples=0. Real observed 0ms is retained. Not time-to-first-token, P95, server compute time or an inferred latency for missing observations.

latency_min_ms.description: Observed client-side total duration in milliseconds; null when latency_samples=0. Real observed 0ms is retained. Not time-to-first-token, P95, server compute time or an inferred latency for missing observations.

latency_samples.description: COMPLETED successful or failed attempts with a non-null observed duration_ms in [0,86400000]. Missing duration, in-flight attempts and UNCERTAIN recovery zero placeholders are excluded.

logical_samples.description: Distinct persisted logical sample IDs with an attempt. Retrying a sample does not create an independent statistical sample.

succeeded.description: COMPLETED attempts with VALID or VALID_WITH_WARNING validity, HTTP 200, no error and valid start/finish timestamps. COMPLETED alone is not success.

success_rate_denominator.description: Equals dispatched, including every retry, UNCERTAIN and in-flight attempt. Never Run completed_samples, valid_sample_count or a substitute request counter.

success_rate_percent.description: 100 * succeeded / dispatched. Null only when dispatched=0. This is the confirmed-success fraction of observed dispatch records, not a future probability; uncertain and in-flight attempts remain in the denominator but are not labelled failed.

ResponseRetentionView.description: Exactly twelve live response-retention metadata fields. Every count is at most attempt_count. The three display categories are mutually exclusive subsets: their sum is at most attempt_count, not necessarily equal to it. These are runtime-validated relations, not expressible by the standalone scalar JSON Schema bounds.

observed_at.description: UTC database observation time of the consistent authorized read snapshot, not report generation time.

policy_days.description: Current response retention policy in days. Zero means no retained response bodies; the summary itself remains metadata.

policy_version.description: Current positive organization retention policy version.

attempt_count.description: All recorded attempts for this run, including non-final attempts.

raw_deleted_count.description: Attempts with verified analysis-response deletion receipts; at most attempt_count. May overlap display categories.

display_deleted_count.description: Attempts with verified response-display deletion receipts; at most attempt_count. Mutually exclusive with display_expired_count and display_retained_count.

display_expired_count.description: Captured display rows still stored but expired under sealed expiry, current policy/cutoff or day window at observed_at; at most attempt_count. Not yet a verified physical deletion.

display_retained_count.description: Captured display rows still stored and not expired at observed_at; at most attempt_count. Storage presence is not authenticated plaintext availability or permission to disclose it.

last_deleted_at.description: Always present. Null iff raw_deleted_count + display_deleted_count is zero; otherwise latest verified response deletion time, nonzero and not after observed_at.

x-runtime-invariants: last_deleted_at is null iff raw_deleted_count + display_deleted_count == 0

EvidenceDisplayData.description: The only implemented response-body disclosure projection. Unavailable is a successful, explicitly reasoned null projection, not a request-only reproduction response.

is_final.description: Whether this terminal attempt is the sample's current final attempt; a published run may also expose a selected non-final terminal attempt.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the authenticated canonical display document, not the source hash, raw response hash or whole HTTP envelope hash.

EvidenceDisplayUnavailable.description: All unavailable statuses require content:null. unavailable_deleted requires a repository-verified response-display deletion receipt bound to the exact attempt/source and a valid signed deletion audit event; row absence alone is not evidence of deletion. An unexplained missing BodyRecorded display row remains a source error (HTTP 503 MI_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE), not a successful deleted projection. Current zero-day policy takes precedence over the deleted display reason. No raw response fallback is permitted.

is_final.description: Whether this terminal attempt is the sample's current final attempt; a published run may also expose a selected non-final terminal attempt.

payload_hash.description: Optional digest of a previously captured display document. Its presence does not imply retained or available plaintext.

content.description: No display document is disclosed; never an empty fabricated response.

source_hash.description: Domain-separated digest binding the checked original request wire hash and normalized response before display redaction; not an analysis payload or HTTP response hash.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the verified original request wire JSON, before display redaction.

template_hash.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of request_json.

request_json.description: Credential-redacted request JSON encoded as a STRING, not a JSON object. Numeric wire values, including signed int64 seed, are preserved without a floating-point round trip. Parse with lossless integer handling. UTF-8 size is at most 1 MiB.

request_changed.description: True exactly when request_hash differs from template_hash.

metadata_omitted.description: Provider request IDs, headers, arbitrary parser warnings and other omitted upstream metadata are not disclosed.

EvidenceDisplayContent.description: Strict version-1 canonical authenticated display-purpose document, produced from the actual captured request and response inside the trusted Worker credential scope. Only the private disclosure codec can emit it after current authorization, retention and audit checks; ordinary sensitive wrappers cannot serialize. Raw analysis evidence is never a fallback.

first_token_ms.description: Null if unobserved; otherwise no greater than duration_ms.

events.description: Null or an ordered bounded event summary; sequence is strictly increasing and arrival_ms is nondecreasing. Gaps are represented by event_summary_partial, not fabricated events.

arrival_ms.description: No greater than the response duration_ms; nondecreasing in this summary.

interval_ms.description: No greater than the response duration_ms.

must_change_password.description: Temporary credentials permit only current-session lookup, logout, logout-all and password change until successfully replaced.

csrf_token.description: Session-bound CSRF token, memory only; not an authentication credential.

headers.description: All custom headers encrypted in the same Secret payload; reserved header names rejected.

max_output_levels.description: 仅custom；严格递增；sequence/jsonl必须有档位。

RunOptions.description: 已实现开发范围：非custom只能覆写预算/并发/重试；custom必须给probe_types、languages和repetitions，支持固定单模式或流式比较。管理员限制在生成Manifest前收紧。baseline、early_stop和观察模式仍待后续M5接入，当前请求不得传入。

max_output_tokens.description: 所有计划逻辑样本的输出上限之和，不是单请求上限。

Estimate.description: 仅计划首次Attempt；input_tokens为保守预算估算。重试独立预留，费用不是上游账单保证。

BaselineInput.description: 创建来源于真实已发布 revision 1 的草稿。official/source 和 region 均为组织声明而非系统认证；到期时间必须在当前时间之后且不超过 365 天。

Review.description: 人工业务判断，独立于不可变算法结果；说明须纯文本展示。当前创建只支持实际发布的开发修订1。

previous_review_id.description: 可省略仅表示已读当前无复核；不接受null。

explanation.description: 复核理由，必须有效Unicode；除LF/TAB外拒绝控制字符与格式字符。不得填写凭证或请求/响应/业务正文。
